map.累积辐照量(kJ/m²) = 照射小时 × 3600 × 辐照度(W/m²) ÷: Cumulative irradiance (kJ/m²) = exposure hours × 3600 × irradiance (W/m²) ÷ 1000. Grades: <50 is grade 1 (very poor), <150 grade 2, <300 grade 3, <600 grade 4, <1200 grade 5, <2400 grade 6, <4800 grade 7, ≥4800 grade 8 (excellent). A higher grade means the color is less likely to fade at that irradiance.
map.辐照度 60 W/m² 照射 2 小时：累积 = 2×3600×60/1000: Irradiance 60 W/m² for 2 hours: cumulative = 2×3600×60/1000 = 432 kJ/m² → grade 4 (slight fading). The same conditions over 5 hours give 1080 kJ/m² → within the grade 5 threshold (good). Actual grading should follow comparison against the blue wool reference.
map.为什么还要用蓝标比对？: Why is blue wool comparison still needed?
map.本工具按累积辐照量做估算，而实际褪色还受光谱分布、温湿度与染料种类影响；标准方法: This tool estimates from cumulative irradiance, while real fading is also affected by spectral distribution, temperature, humidity and dye type; the standard method (xenon exposure with blue wool references) is the arbiter.
map.等级是按“耐受到多少辐照”理解吗？: Is the grade understood as 'how much irradiance it withstands'?
map.可以这么理解：等级越高，说明样品在越高辐照量下仍保持颜色稳定；本表把达到各等级所: That is a reasonable reading: a higher grade means the sample keeps its color stable at a higher irradiance; this table treats the cumulative irradiance required to reach each grade as the threshold.
